variables.name: default_workspace_id
variables.note: Workspace ID used by the built-in Default data product in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: default_warehouse_id
variables.note: Fabric item ID of the warehouse used by the built-in Default data product in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: default_warehouse_endpoint
variables.note: SQL endpoint for the warehouse used by the built-in Default data product in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: default_warehouse_name
variables.note: Display name of the warehouse used by the built-in Default data product in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: central_metadata_workspace_id
variables.note: Workspace ID that hosts the central metadata warehouse. Usually matches default_workspace_id in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: central_metadata_warehouse_id
variables.note: Fabric item ID of the central metadata warehouse used for logs, schemas, watermarks, and shared datastore lookup.

variables.name: central_metadata_warehouse_name
variables.note: Display/database name of the central metadata warehouse. Usually matches default_warehouse_name in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: central_metadata_warehouse_endpoint
variables.note: SQL endpoint for the central metadata warehouse. Usually matches default_warehouse_endpoint in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: default_lakehouse_id
variables.note: Fabric item ID of the lakehouse used by the built-in Default data product in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: default_lakehouse_name
variables.note: Display name of the lakehouse used by the built-in Default data product in single-workspace deployments.

variables.name: pipeline_workspace_id
variables.note: Workspace ID used by agents and external callers to invoke orchestration pipelines. In single-workspace deployments, this matches default_workspace_id; feature workspace setup overrides it to the feature workspace.

variables.name: spark_compute_workspace_id
variables.note: Workspace ID where Spark notebooks are deployed and executed.

variables.name: notebook_id_batch_processing
variables.note: Fabric item ID of NB_Batch_Processing, used by pipelines and local run helpers to start framework batch execution.

variables.name: notebook_id_exploratory_data_analysis
variables.note: Fabric item ID of NB_Run_Exploratory_Data_Analysis, used by the exploratory data analysis pipeline.

variables.name: default_spark_environment_id
variables.note: Fabric Environment ID applied to notebook runs when no per-run spark_environment_id override is provided.

variables.name: runtime_environment
variables.note: Logical environment label for environment-scoped DQ and reconciliation checks. Set to dev, qa, or prod.

variables.name: custom_function_load_mode
variables.note: Custom function loading mode for NB_Batch_Processing. Valid values: file, notebook. CI/CD stamps file for QA and PROD.

variables.name: is_feature_workspace
variables.note: Whether this is an ephemeral feature workspace. Base value false; the FeatureWorkspaceConfig value set overrides it to true. Threaded into the runtime context and excluded from durable cross-product lineage discovery.
